message.content:
I'll search for the definition of "monogamous" for you.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>monogamous definition meaning</query>

Based on the search results, **monogamous** is an adjective with two main meanings:

1. **In relationships/marriage**: Having only one romantic or sexual partner at a time; practicing or advocating for marriage to only one person at a time. This is the most common usage in modern contexts.

2. **In biology/zoology**: Having only one mate at a time or during a breeding season. Some animals are monogamous, forming exclusive pair bonds.

The word comes from the Greek roots: *mono-* (one, single) + *gamos* (marriage).

**Related forms:**
- **Monogamy** (noun): the practice or state of being married to or having a sexual relationship with only one person at a time
- **Monogamously** (adverb)

**Antonym:** Polygamous (having multiple partners or spouses simultaneously)

The term is most frequently used to describe exclusive romantic/sexual relationships, but can also apply more broadly to any exclusive one-to-one pairing.

Sources:
1. https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/monogamous
2. https://www.dictionary.com/browse/monogamous
3. https://www.oed.com/search/dictionary/?scope=Entries&q=monogamous
